_comment: TASK-B10 'What is this?' table. Match priority: names > folders > extensions. Globs are lower case and volume-relative: * = inside one folder, **/ = any number of folders. Folder rules also cover everything inside the folder; the deepest matching folder wins. Wording: never call a file safe to delete; hints are 'usually' or 'careful'.

whatsappBackup.title: WhatsApp encrypted backup
whatsappBackup.body: Part of WhatsApp's local backup. Only WhatsApp can read it. Deleting it can lose chats or media that aren't backed up anywhere else.

whatsappChats.title: WhatsApp chat backup
whatsappChats.body: An encrypted copy of your WhatsApp chats, made by WhatsApp's daily local backup. Only WhatsApp can read it. WhatsApp uses it when you restore chats on this phone.

whatsappContacts.title: WhatsApp contacts backup
whatsappContacts.body: An encrypted copy of WhatsApp's contact list. Only WhatsApp can read it.

whatsappStickerBackup.title: WhatsApp sticker backup (encrypted)
whatsappStickerBackup.body: WhatsApp keeps an encrypted copy of each saved sticker here, so stickers come back when you restore WhatsApp. The random-looking name is normal. Only WhatsApp can read it.

whatsappSettingsBackup.title: WhatsApp settings backup (encrypted)
whatsappSettingsBackup.body: Part of WhatsApp's local backup: settings, wallpaper or the sticker list. Only WhatsApp can read it. WhatsApp uses it when you restore on this phone.

whatsappScratch.title: WhatsApp scratch file
whatsappScratch.body: A temporary file WhatsApp made while sending, receiving or sharing something. These are usually left over once WhatsApp is done with them.

whatsappTrash.title: WhatsApp's deleted files
whatsappTrash.body: Files WhatsApp moved aside after you deleted them in a chat. WhatsApp clears this folder itself from time to time.

whatsappStatus.title: WhatsApp status
whatsappStatus.body: A copy of a status you viewed. WhatsApp removes these by itself after about a day.

whatsappVoiceNotes.title: WhatsApp voice message
whatsappVoiceNotes.body: A voice message sent or received in a WhatsApp chat. WhatsApp groups them in folders by week. Deleting it removes the recording from the chat on this phone.

whatsappStickers.title: WhatsApp sticker
whatsappStickers.body: A sticker sent or received in a WhatsApp chat.

whatsappWallpaper.title: WhatsApp wallpaper
whatsappWallpaper.body: A chat wallpaper picked in WhatsApp.

whatsappMedia.title: WhatsApp media
whatsappMedia.body: A photo, video, voice message or document sent or received in WhatsApp. Files in 'Sent' folders are copies of what you sent. Deleting it removes it from the chat on this phone.

telegramMedia.title: Telegram media
telegramMedia.body: A file sent or received in a Telegram chat. Telegram usually keeps a copy on its servers, so the chat may still be able to download it again.

telegramCache.title: Telegram cache
telegramCache.body: Media Telegram downloaded while you scrolled through chats. Telegram downloads it again when it's needed and can clear it in its own Storage usage settings.

adVideoCache.title: Ad video cache
adVideoCache.body: Videos an advertising kit inside an app or game saved so ads start quickly. They aren't your files; the app may download them again.

thumbCache.title: Thumbnail cache
thumbCache.body: Small preview pictures a gallery or music app made so lists load faster. The app makes them again when needed.

faceCache.title: Face recognition data
faceCache.body: Data a gallery app keeps about faces it found in your photos. Removing it can make the app scan your photos again.

windowsThumbCache.title: Windows thumbnail cache
windowsThumbCache.body: Windows made this when the folder was opened on a PC. Android doesn't use it.

windowsFolderInfo.title: Windows folder settings
windowsFolderInfo.body: Windows stores how a folder looks in this file. Android doesn't use it.

macFolderInfo.title: Mac folder settings
macFolderInfo.body: A Mac stores how a folder looks in this file. Android doesn't use it.

macResourceFork.title: Mac extra data
macResourceFork.body: A Mac writes these next to files copied from it. Android doesn't use them.

nomedia.title: Gallery blocker
nomedia.body: An empty marker file. It tells gallery and music apps not to show the files in this folder. Deleting it makes them show up in galleries.

systemTrashed.title: In the system trash
systemTrashed.body: Android keeps deleted photos and videos like this for about 30 days, then removes them. A gallery app or KFM's Trash can restore it.

systemPending.title: Unfinished file
systemPending.body: An app started saving this file and hasn't finished. If nothing is saving right now, it's usually left over from an interrupted save; Android cleans these up after a while.

kfmTrash.title: KFM's deleted files
kfmTrash.body: Files you deleted in KFM wait here before they're removed for good. Restore them from KFM's Trash.

trashFolder.title: An app's trash
trashFolder.body: A folder where an app or computer keeps deleted files until they're removed for good.

lostDir.title: Recovered pieces
lostDir.body: Android puts pieces of files here that it recovered after a storage error, often from a memory card removed while in use. They usually can't be opened.

androidSecure.title: Android app storage
androidSecure.body: A folder older Android versions used for apps moved to the memory card.

appCache.title: App cache
appCache.body: Files an app keeps so things load faster. The app usually makes them again when needed; its own settings or Android's App info can clear them.

videoCache.title: Video cache
videoCache.body: Parts of videos an app saved while playing them, so they play smoothly again. The app downloads them again when needed.

appData.title: An app's own files
appData.body: Files an app keeps for itself, such as downloads, settings or offline content. Removing them can reset the app or lose what it saved.

appMedia.title: Media saved by an app
appMedia.body: Media an app saved in its own folder on shared storage. The app may still use it.

obbData.title: Game or app data
obbData.body: Extra data a game or app downloaded, such as graphics or levels. Without it the app downloads it again or may stop working.

tempFile.title: Temporary file
tempFile.body: An app's scratch file, often left over after a download, an edit or sharing. Usually not needed once the app that made it is done with it.

apk.title: Android app installer
apk.body: An installer for an Android app. Once the app is installed, the installer is usually no longer needed. Only install apps from sources you trust.

partialDownload.title: Unfinished download
partialDownload.body: A download that is still running or didn't finish. It usually can't be opened.

torrent.title: Torrent file
torrent.body: A small file that tells a torrent app what to download.

logFile.title: Log file
logFile.body: A record an app writes about what it did, mostly for fixing problems.

backupCopy.title: Backup copy
backupCopy.body: A backup an app or you made of another file. Check that you don't need it before deleting.

appDatabase.title: App database
appDatabase.body: Data an app stores in a database, such as messages, settings or a list of files. Usually only that app reads it.

appDataFile.title: App data file
appDataFile.body: Data an app saved in its own format. Only that app knows what's inside.

contactCard.title: Contact card
contactCard.body: One or more contacts, for example exported from Contacts. Opening it can import them.

calendarEvent.title: Calendar event
calendarEvent.body: An event or invitation. Opening it can add it to a calendar.

gpsTrack.title: GPS track
gpsTrack.body: A route or places recorded by a sports, hiking or map app.

subtitles.title: Subtitles
subtitles.body: Subtitles for a video with the same name.

playlist.title: Playlist
playlist.body: A list of songs or videos for a player app.

font.title: Font
font.body: A typeface an app or document uses.

rawPhoto.title: RAW photo
rawPhoto.body: An unprocessed photo straight from the camera sensor, for editing. A normal JPEG of the same shot often sits next to it.

heicPhoto.title: HEIC photo
heicPhoto.body: A photo in the space-saving HEIF format, used by newer phones and iPhones.

webpImage.title: WebP image
webpImage.body: An image format used by websites and stickers.

voiceMessage.title: Voice message or recording
voiceMessage.body: Audio in a format messaging and recorder apps use for speech.

audioRecording.title: Audio
audioRecording.body: Music or a recording in the M4A format.

phoneVideo.title: Phone video
phoneVideo.body: A video in the 3GP format, used by older phones and some messaging apps.

ebook.title: E-book
ebook.body: A book for an e-reader app.
